items.title: North Korean Hackers Compromise Widely Used Axios Package to Infect Windows, macOS, and Linux Systems
items.description: A major software supply chain attack has struck the JavaScript ecosystem after threat actors slipped a malicious dependency into the widely used axios NPM package. The poisoned releases, axios 1.14.1 and 0.30.4, pulled in plain-crypto-js and quietly delivered the WAVESHAPER.V2 backdoor to Windows, macOS, and Linux systems during installation. items.description: Two high-severity vulnerabilities have been discovered in libpng, the widely used reference library for reading and writing PNG images. These flaws allow attackers to trigger process crashes, leak sensitive information, and potentially execute arbitrary code by convincing a system to process a crafted PNG file.
